cards.stem: About how many paired units carry instructions for a human being
cards.quote: The human genome contains about 3 billion base pairs that spell out the instructions for making and maintaining a human being.
cards.hint: Recall the scale of the full set of instructions

cards.stem: Which pairing always occurs between the four chemical bases
cards.hint: Think about the fixed partners in the double helix

cards.stem: What is the constant partner for cytosine in the double helix
cards.hint: Remember the second part of the pairing statement

cards.stem: What does determining the order of the four building blocks called bases accomplish
cards.quote: DNA sequencing determines the order of the four chemical building blocks - called "bases" - that make up the DNA molecule.
cards.hint: Focus on the term for the basic units of the molecule
